create_relocate_env: create a RelocateEnvV0 instance for a MuJoCo hand manipulation relocate task
step_simulation: step the MuJoCo simulation forward with an action and return observation, reward, done flag, and env info
get_reward_dict: get a dictionary of dense and sparse reward components from observation vectors
get_obs: get the current observation vector containing hand joints and position errors
evaluate_success: evaluate success rate across rollout paths and log reward metrics to a logger
